request: Modify the accepted links service: prevent caching of per-link statistics and fix the legacy redirect endpoint counting HEAD as a visit.
criteria: GET /api/v1/stats/{code} for a live link includes Cache-Control directives private and no-store.
HEAD /r/{code} preserves the redirect status and Location of a live link without incrementing its visit count. A subsequent GET still increments the count.
The existing creation, resolution, reporting and expiry behaviors continue to pass their regression checks.
